coaching_note: This is a kickoff/estimate-build call on an existing profile rather than a cold pitch, so treat the Section 2 probing gaps (home size, packing needs, moving stressors) with a grain of salt — some of that may already have been captured on the original quote form and just wasn't re-confirmed on this call; the booking-close gaps (no BOLDED email recap, no "reply with corrections," no hours/contact info, customer's name never used) are the more actionable, unambiguous misses here.
phone_presence_notes: Friendly and polite in tone (casual affirmations, warm sign-off) but transactional overall — the customer's name is never used and there's little rapport beyond the task.
